text: ならば　ようしゃは　せんぞ！

structure.jp: ようしゃは　せんぞ！

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: せん is an old-man form of しない, 'do not do'. ようしゃは　せん = 'I will not show mercy'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is rough, manly speech that pushes a statement at the listener like a warning. せんぞ = 'I won't, I tell you!'.
